New York, New York · eat

Restaurants in New York for cyclists

Where to eat in New York the night before a ride and the afternoon after. Nothing fancy. Real food, real portions, places that are open when you need them.

For: TD Five Boro Bike Tour.

Restaurants in New York for cyclists, listed

  1. Fraunces Tavern

    American tavern · 54 Pearl Street, New York, NY 10004

    Bar and restaurant in a 1762 landmark two blocks from the start; sit-down dinner the night before.

  2. Adrienne's Pizzabar

    Pizza · 54 Stone Street, New York, NY 10004

    Square pies on the cobblestoned Stone Street, steps from Bowling Green.

  3. Leo's Bagels

    Bagels and deli · 3 Hanover Square, New York, NY 10004

    Hand-rolled, kettle-boiled bagels since 2007; pre-ride breakfast.

  4. Crown Shy

    Contemporary, European technique · 70 Pine Street, New York, NY 10005

    Post-tour celebration dinner in a landmark art deco tower; book ahead.
